profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Red Hat | Operating Systems, Virtualization, Linux
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer at Red Hat with over six years of expertise in virtualization and operating systems. Contributed to VMware integration and support, collaborating with internal teams and external customers to resolve critical issues and enhance product functionality. Played a key role in maintaining engineering environments for RHEV and VMware, ensuring seamless operations for the organization.  

Actively contributed to Red Hat's knowledge management and documentation systems, ensuring clarity and accuracy for global stakeholders. Supported testing efforts with QE automation teams and facilitated technical training across departments. Committed to delivering innovative solutions and fostering collaboration to drive customer success.

positions.title: Software Developer - Red Hat Satellite 6
positions.description:
• Investigate & troubleshoot high priority issues for critical customers and helping our Global Support Team.
•  Work as the lead for VMware integration and support for both internal teams, and external customers with Foreman and Katello.
• Contribute to global Red Hat knowledge management system in the process of working
customer issues
• Work with our documentation team to help make sure our documentation is clear and accurate, and submit patches in docs when needed.
• Help our QE automation team test bugs manually as well as give technical training's to QE, support, management.
• Maintain Engineering RHEV and VMWare environment for reproducers and development machines.

positions.title: Software Maintence Engineer - Red Hat Satellite 6
positions.description:

• Investigate & troubleshoot high priority issues for critical customers.
• Regularly collaborate with in-house support engineers and developers to drive creative
solutions and improve customer satisfaction. Work on bugs and submit patches to push development along.
• Contribute to global Red Hat knowledge management system in the process of working
customer issues
• Help develop Red Hat Satellite 6 and the Katello upstream project.
• Work on patches and bugs assigned from Engineering Management. 
• Maintain Engineering RHEV and VMWare environment for reproducers and development machines.

Tech Support
positions.description:
Helped Customers solve any TV, Internet, Phone related issues.
Called customers after service calls, following up making sure services were working.
Analyzed signal data on Arris modem's and CMTS and setup service calls accordingly.

positions.title: Technical Support
positions.description:
Assisted customers with handset, switch and mta issues.
Helped customers find upgrades that would meet their needs.
Analyzed customers bills and usage for data and voice solutions.
Worked with switch techs in identifying dropped calls in tower areas.

positions.title: Network Administrator
positions.description:
Developed an computer network of 35 computers and 3 servers.
Setup and upgraded all workstations through images, and setup patch management systems.
Setup a network running around Novell and Red Hat Linux. Created a Groupwise email system for intra office communication.
